description: This file defines the GroupDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface to provide data access operations related to 'Group' entities, including methods to retrieve groups based on permissions, group types, and IDs.

classes.name: GroupDao
classes.description: An interface for data access operations related to 'Group' entities, extending generic DAO capabilities and adding methods specific to permission and group type queries.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects based on a set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects filtered by a specific GroupType.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects based on a set of group IDs.
